item.title: ‘Freedom fighters' dreams continue to inspire us’: Leaders extend wishes on 80th I-Day
item.summary: Prime Minister Modi and other leaders extended Independence Day greetings to citizens. They remembered freedom fighters and highlighted their visions for India's future. Modi emphasized progress and a developed nation powered by 140 crore Indians. Kharge expressed concerns over constitutional values and democratic institutions facing challenges. Other leaders also conveyed wishes and called for national progress and unity.
